claim_comment: Closing the NCM boundary only after it compiles independently in the monorepo, depends solely on the provider API plus SHA-256, exposes no raw coding identity to the licensed surface, preserves every provider-neutral request control and payload, selects no execution topology, and fails malformed or unsupported surface behavior closed.
retry_note: The second materialization confirmed production API alignment. This retry also uses the accepted Vec builder inputs in tests and removes an unnecessary mutable binding in cancellation coverage; topology-neutral behavior is unchanged.

checks.name: workspace resolves with the NCM boundary
canonical provider Rust bindings remain generated
upstream patch footprint and dependency rules remain valid
working tree has no whitespace damage

acceptance_criteria: The crate compiles without modifying, copying, or selecting licensed NCM behavior or execution topology.
Its only dependencies are the provider-neutral API and SHA-256; it imports no TraceDecay store, database, code-index, root, Native adapter, OCEAN, host, daemon, dashboard, or transport crate.

Raw profile, project, repository, worktree, branch, and agent-session identifiers stay in TraceDecay; the licensed surface receives only a deterministic exact-scope namespace digest and canonical provider-neutral payload/control values.

Wrong identity, undeclared capability, terminal scope/operation mismatch, cancelled/deadline requests, and malformed post-effect replies fail explicitly, with mutating malformed replies classified as effect_unknown rather than no-effect success.
close_reason: Added the isolated topology-neutral NCM provider boundary with opaque exact-scope namespaces, canonical request preservation, explicit capability/identity admission, and fail-closed response validation without implementing or modifying NCM.
close_comment: Evidence: crates/tracedecay-memory-provider-ncm is a strict Rust 2024 product-owned crate depending only on tracedecay-memory-provider-api and sha2. NcmProviderAdapter accepts only the reserved ncm identity, derives a deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 namespace from the full admitted TraceDecay scope, maps handshake and calls into NcmSurface types that contain no raw coding identities, preserves registration/readiness/request/operation/idempotency/generation/control/payload/capability/extension values, and reattaches exact scope only after a compatible response. It selects no in-process/process/socket/database topology and contains no NCM implementation. Mandatory calls are capability-gated before the surface; cancellation/deadline preflight prevents contact; wrong targets and handshake misuse are typed invalid requests; malformed read replies become contract_violation and malformed mutating replies become effect_unknown with unknown committed effect. Focused tests prove stable/opaque namespace derivation, worktree/branch/session isolation, scope reattachment, canonical field preservation, no surface call for undeclared/wrong/cancelled requests, and fail-closed malformed responses. Workspace/lock changes are convergence-mapped and API, fabric, Native, generated-binding, patch-policy, fmt, Clippy, and test gates remain green.
